response:
FADE IN:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

We see a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor, merchants hawking their wares, and peasants scurrying about. But amidst the chaos, we notice something peculiar. The king, a stout and regal figure with a thick beard, is pacing back and forth in front of a grand, ornate mirror.

KING (he) addresses his trusted advisor, a bespectacled wizard named ZORVATH (he).

KING
(to Zorvath)
I have a vision, my friend. A vision of a new era for our empire. An era of... of... (he searches for the right words)...of... of... (he snaps his fingers)...of VAPORWAVE!

ZORVATH
(confused)
Vaporwave, Your Majesty?

KING
(nodding)
Yes! The swirling clouds, the distorted images, the eerie, pulsing beats. It's the perfect aesthetic for our empire.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king, surrounded by his courtiers and advisors, begins to describe his vision.

KING
(to the assembly)
Imagine it, my friends. Our flags, once proud and bold, now feature distorted, glitchy patterns. Our coats of arms, once simple and elegant, now resemble VHS tapes playing in reverse. Our architecture, once grand and imposing, now appears as if it's been warped and melted like wax in a furnace.

ZORVATH
(skeptical)
But, Your Majesty, won't this... this... (he searches for the right words)...this vaporwave aesthetic be... be... (he shrugs)...unseemly?

KING
(firmly)
No, Zorvath! This is the future! This is the way of the empire! (he gestures grandly) Behold!

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is transformed. The buildings seem to ripple and distort, like the surface of a pond. The flags wave in the breeze, but instead of the usual colors, they feature swirling patterns of pink and blue. The knights, once proud and armored, now wear clothing that resembles neon-colored, oversized sweatpants.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king, surrounded by his courtiers and advisors, sits on a throne that resembles a giant, ornate VHS player. He presses a button, and the room is filled with the sound of distorted, pulsing beats.

KING
(to the assembly)
This, my friends, is the sound of the future! This is the beat of the empire!

ZORVATH
(covering his ears)
For the love of all that is holy...

KING
(laughing)
Ah, Zorvath! You just don't understand! This is the way of the vaporwave!

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is now a surreal, dreamlike landscape. The buildings seem to melt and warp, like wax in a furnace. The people, once dressed in traditional clothing, now wear clothing that resembles neon-colored, oversized sweatpants. The king, surrounded by his courtiers and advisors, rides a horse that resembles a giant, ornate VHS player.

KING
(to the assembly)
This, my friends, is the empire of the future! This is the way of the vaporwave!

ZORVATH
(resigned)
I suppose, Your Majesty, that this is the way of the empire now.

KING
(smiling)
Ah, Zorvath! You're finally seeing the vision!

FADE TO BLACK.
